test_title: PYST 11: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven students P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R is an immediate neighbour of both T and U. S is sitting third to the left of R and immediate right of P. P is sitting second to the right of T. Q is an immediate neighbour of both T and P. V is immediate left of U. What is the position of P with respect to V?
solution:
Explanation : 

 
• S is sitting third to the left of R and immediate right of P. 
 
• P is sitting second to the right of T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e178f4edf51f9911ce788c1b67fe0af9ea1fc33091541013b7296828c81f56eb.png] 

 
• R is an immediate neighbour of both T and U.
 
• Q is an immediate neighbour of both T and P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39b4a52e3ed4c597fbe032020724137e903e441f746298116c83470ac707bc0b.png] 

 
• V is immediate left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a63b25acab1b6e7d3adf35d848062ad2c69755b4a8a3abd6b13b7f23bef08b.png] 

**P is second to the left of V. **

Hence,** "Option 2"** is the** **correct answer.
